exposure: rectangular-shaped hemostatic sutures in cesarean delivery for PAS
cohort: The study included 13 pregnant women with Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS) disorders below 22 weeks of gestational age who underwent cesarean delivery with rectangular-shaped hemostatic sutures.
finding: Surgical management of second-trimester Placenta Accreta Spectrum disorders using rectangular-shaped hemostatic sutures resulted in an average estimated blood loss of 761.54 mL and a 92.3% success rate for conservative surgery.
gest_age: Below 22 weeks (specifically 13-17 weeks for 11 out of 13 cases)
